blocks.text: Need some extra storage in your life? This storage cabinet from the Sauder Select collection features four adjustable shelves and a full-width upper shelf so you can stash bins, books, pantry items and more. This storage cabinet with doors offers the perfect amount of style and practicality for any room in your home. Finished in a sleek White and detailed with frame and panel doors and sides, this tall cabinet is ideal for the kitchen, basement, garage, or anywhere you need a storage solution. We hope you like what you see. Sauder designers travel the world and bring back the best and latest in style, finish, and color trends. This inspiring world travel is evident in the cutting edge and innovative furniture solutions we offer to you!

items: SOLVE YOUR STORAGE NEEDS WITH STYLE – This double-door storage cabinet offers four adjustable shelves, providing customizable storage options for your home office, pantry, or craft room
ADJUSTABLE SHELVES FOR VERSATILITY – Easily store items of varying heights and widths, from pantry essentials to craft supplies, ensuring everything has its place
IDEAL FOR MULTIPLE ROOMS – Perfect for the living room or utility room, this cabinet helps you maintain an organized and functional space wherever you need it
ELEGANT WHITE FINISH - Finished in a bright and neutral White, this cabinet complements any decor style, adding a touch of modern elegance to your home
BUILT TO LAST - Crafted for durability, this cabinet features smooth operation and easy assembly, making it a reliable addition to your home
EASY ASSEMBLY – Designed for quick and straightforward assembly, so you can enjoy your new storage solution in no time
MULTIFUNCTIONAL STORAGE SOLUTION – Use it as a shoe cabinet, pantry cabinet, or for bathroom linens, adapting to your storage needs as they change
5-YEAR LIMITED WARRANTY - Your investment is protected with a 5-year limited warranty for lasting peace of mind
